name: component-cop
shortDescription: Chrome DevTools extension that audits React apps for component duplication, inconsistent styling, and hardcoded colors.
description: component-cop is a Chrome DevTools extension that audits a running React app in real time. It flags component duplication (similar trees that could be consolidated), inconsistent styling across the page, and hardcoded color values that should be design tokens — giving frontend engineers a fast, in-browser way to find drift before it ships.
